# Cognitive Brand Lab (品牌科学实验室™)
> The science of brand architecture and cross-border commercial strategy. Powered by BrandOS™ by Ran.

- [Home](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/): Cognitive Brand Lab Manifesto and BrandOS™ architecture.
- [About & Origin](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/about): Principal Investigator Ran's cross-disciplinary background (Digital Marketing Master's, CBAP, Google Data Analytics & Digital Marketing).
- [Essays Archive](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/essays): Empirical research monographs on Byron Sharp's How Brands Grow, Michael Spence Costly Signaling, and BCG/Simon pricing models.
- [M1 Demand Radar](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m1-brand-foundations): Byron Sharp CEPs, Clayton Christensen JTBD, VOC NLP text mining.
- [M2 Unfakeable Trust](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m2-behavioral-science): Spence Costly Signaling, Separating Equilibrium, Distinctive Brand Assets.
- [M3 Value Pricing](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m3-strategic-pricing): Good-Better-Best (GBB) Tiering, Price Waterfall Leakage Audit, 65%+ Gross Margin.
- [M4 Algo Resonance](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m4-algorithmic-resonance): Meta DLRM, Creator Whitelisting, Broad 1-CBO Media Buying.
- [M5 Rapid Conversion](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m5-conversion-engineering): MECLABS Heuristics, 100px Near-Ground Evidence Chain, Core Web Vitals.
- [M6 Compound Retention](https://cognitivebrandlab.org/modules/m6-compounding-retention): Rubin Causal Inference, Geo-Lift Holdout iROAS, 6 Adaptive Lifecycle Flows.
